content:
mira: Quick roll-call — sampleflow quickstart + SDK docs are in the chop window. Changelog cutoff is ~20h from now. Two immediate asks: (1) sample-app e2e is failing in CI, someone needs to own a patch, (2) who will take the changelog + docs snippet?

Tom: I can take the e2e fix. I think it's the Docker base image bump; tests started failing after the alpine->buster switch. Reproduced locally. Error in the logs: 
```
FAIL tests/test_integration.py::test_quickstart_end_to_end
AssertionError: Expected 200, got 502
requests.exceptions.ProxyError: Error connecting to 127.0.0.1:8080
```

Kendra: tagging on that — the local repro I ran showed a missing apt dependency (libpq-dev) in the container. Quick patch is to add it to Dockerfile. If Tom wants, I can open the PR with the minimal change + CI fix.

Tom: pls do that, Kendra. I'll drop the failing test fix in the sampleapp repo as #712 and link to this thread. Need a quick review from someone on infra changes.

jen: I can own the changelog entry and the short docs snippet for "sampleflow quickstart: base image compatibility". I'll draft the changelog PR and ping product for sign-off. Any blockers on wording?

mira: awesome — assign owners: Tom/Kendra on sample-app CI patch, Jen on changelog/docs. ETA on PRs?

Kendra: opening PR in ~15m. Labeling as "ci, quickstart" and adding a short description. Will include the `apt-get install libpq-dev` line.

Tom: PR #712 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/712 — please review. I've also queued a re-run of the flaky e2e job: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9981 (re-run in progress).

devex-oncall: CI rerun completed — e2e job passed on retry (build 9981.2) :white_check_mark:

mira: great — @jen if you can drop the changelog PR once Tom's fix merges, we should be within cutoff. Also need to confirm quickstart Docker tag we publish (do we bump to :stable-2026-03 or keep existing?). Any preference?

jen: I'll keep the changelog entry generic about the base image fix and include the PR reference. For the published tag, I'd prefer we keep existing stable tag and publish a patch tag (stable-2026-03.1) to avoid breaking consumers. Will coordinate with release infra to push the patch tag after merge.

Kendra: merged CI patch to main (commit 9c4d2f). Left a note in PR about backport to the 1.x branch.

Tom: main fix verified locally, new e2e run is green. Will follow up with the backport PR.

mira: summary checklist (please react when done):
- [ ] PR review for sample-app patch (owner: infra/devex)
- [x] CI rerun passed (devex-oncall)
- [ ] Changelog PR (owner: jen)
- [ ] Publish patch docker tag (owner: release infra)

Please ping here when each item completes. :raised_hands:
